q: Who was the first President of Nigeria?
exp: Nnamdi Azikiwe was the first President of Nigeria.

q: In which year was the Nigerian civil war?
exp: The Nigerian civil war was from 1967 to 1970.

q: Who was the first Prime Minister of Nigeria?
exp: Abubakar Tafawa Balewa was the first Prime Minister of Nigeria.

q: The amalgamation of Northern and Southern Nigeria occurred in...
exp: The amalgamation of Nigeria was completed in 1914.

q: The capital of Nigeria before Abuja was...
exp: Lagos was the capital of Nigeria before Abuja.
